blocks.prompt: 2. Insert four real geometric means between \(3\) and \(96\).
blocks.explanation:
"Four G.M.s insert karein" ka matlab hai: 3 aur 96 ke beech chaar aise numbers rakhein ke saare chhe numbers mil kar G.P. ban jayein.
Find kya karna hai? \(G_1, G_2, G_3, G_4\).
Plan: 96 chhata (6th) term hai, is liye \(96 = 3r^{5}\) se real \(r\) nikalenge, phir 3 ko baar baar \(r\) se multiply karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: G.P. \(3, G_1, G_2, G_3, G_4, 96\).
Humein find karna hai: chaar real G.M.
Tareeqa: Chaar means aur do diye gaye numbers mila kar \(4 + 2 = 6\) terms bante hain. Pehla term \(a_1 = 3\) aur aakhri (6th) term \(a_6 = 96\). General term \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\) se \(r\) nikal aayega, aur \(r\) mil gaya to saare means mil jayenge.

6th term ka formula likhein
\[a_6 = a_1 r^{5}\]
\[96 = 3r^{5}\]
Kyun: 6th term ke liye \(r\) ki power \(6 - 1 = 5\) hoti hai, kyunke pehle term se chhatay term tak paanch qadam (steps) hain aur har qadam par ek dafa \(r\) se multiply hota hai.
Dhyan dein: Aksar students terms ginte waqt sirf 4 means gin lete hain aur \(n = 4\) ya \(n = 5\) le lete hain. Yaad rakhein: \(n\) means hon to kul terms \(n + 2\) hote hain.

\(r\) nikalein
\[r^{5} = 32 = 2^{5}\]
\[r = 2\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 3 se divide kiya to \(r^{5} = 32\). \(2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 32\), is liye \(r = 2\). Sawal ne "real" means maange hain, aur odd power (paanchvi power) ka sirf ek real root hota hai, is liye sirf \(r = 2\).

Chaaron means nikalein
\[G_1 = 3(2) = 6\]
\[G_2 = 6(2) = 12\]
\[G_3 = 12(2) = 24\]
\[G_4 = 24(2) = 48\]
Kyun: G.P. mein har agla term pichle term ko \(r\) se multiply karne se banta hai. Is liye 3 se shuru kar ke har dafa 2 se multiply karte gaye.

Tasdeeq: agla term 96 aana chahiye
\[48 \times 2 = 96\]
Kyun: \(G_4\) ke baad aakhri term aata hai. Woh 96 aaya, jo diya gaya tha, is liye humare chaaron means sahi hain.
